item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Qadir's electric cell joined to a small lamp. End P is the raised metal cap. End Q is the flat metal base.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: P is the positive terminal and Q is the negative terminal; a closed path through the lamp lets the cell run the circuit.
options.B: P is the negative terminal and Q is the positive terminal; the raised cap is always negative.
options.C: Both P and Q are positive terminals, so the lamp can glow without a return path.
options.D: The cell can run the lamp even if the wire at Q is left disconnected.
